newsitem.title: JAPAN: Foreign cars to get more space at Tokyo Motor Show.
newsitem.headline: Foreign cars to get more space at Tokyo Motor Show.

text.p: Space for foreign vehicles at the Tokyo Motor Show will be increased by more than a quarter next autumn, the Japan Motor Industrial Federation said on Tuesday.
Foreign cars and trucks will be allocated 13,605 square metres, up 25.9 percent from the previous show. Space for Japanese cars will decline 15.6 percent to 16,640 square metres.
The federation increased space for foreign cars by 8.6 percent at the last show, held in 1995.
The 32nd Tokyo Motor Show will run for 13 days from October 24 in Makuhari, Chiba Prefecture, near Tokyo. The event is held every two years.
The show will include displays of cars, trucks, motorcycles, parts and new technology by 318 companies from 15 countries, compared with 325 manufacturers from 14 countries at the last show.
Six foreign governments will display automobile components, unchanged from the last show, and the Japan Electric Vehicle Association will display electric cars.
